Hello, opentelemetry 0.92 was [just released](https://github.com/ocaml-tracing/ocaml-opentelemetry/releases/tag/v0.92). It is an OCaml implementation of the https://opentelemetry.io/ standard for observability. This release improves performance of random generation of trace Ids/span Ids, and adds support for head sampling. We are getting close to a 1.0 release.
Cheerios!
